name: academia-online
description: Plataforma educativa web + api preparada para crecer a app de estudio

scripts.build: npm run build -w @academia/shared && npm run build -w @academia/api && npm run build -w @academia/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @academia/web && npm run lint -w @academia/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @academia/shared && npm run typecheck -w @academia/api && npm run typecheck -w @academia/web
